mechanism_claims.claim_text: RMD, VOR, and PNB inhibit recombinant human HDAC isoenzymes; RMD has sub-nM to low-nM IC50 values for several HDACs in Table 2.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RMD/romidepsin and comparator HDAC inhibitors in this paper
direct_assay_types: recombinant human HDAC isoenzyme fluorogenic substrate IC50 assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is HDAC inhibition and HIV latency reversal context, not antimicrobial membrane activity.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RMD activates latent HIV expression in an in vitro primary CD4 T-cell latency model and ex vivo CD4 T-cell cultures, measured by p24/HIV RNA endpoints.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RMD/romidepsin in HIV latency reversal assays
direct_assay_types: HIV RNA qPCR/COBAS viral RNA quantification
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports HIV expression induction, not clearance of infected cells or clinical efficacy in HIV patients.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RMD treatment is associated with sustained inhibition of cell-associated HDAC activity in resting CD4 T cells alongside HIV RNA induction.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RMD in resting CD4 T cells from cART-suppressed patients
